scope: First frost and first snow only; v5 inputs were owner-accepted geometry/season references. Other ten playback scenes unchanged.
method: Single supplied v5 image per request, no competing photo references. Gemini lighting edit; resize to1280x848; align.swift robust global affine to corresponding v5 source. Restore original137x45 MLS patch at0,803; WebPquality90. No dense warp, lighting-transfer fallback or second color grade.

images.prompt:
Perform a meticulous LIGHTING-ONLY photographic retouch of this ONE supplied image. The existing composition and seasonal state are already correct. Do NOT create a new scene. Output the same photograph with more natural, inviting exposure and ambience, not a flat dark filter.
HIGHEST PRIORITY: EXACT IMAGE REGISTRATION. Treat this as a locked pixel canvas. Every physical edge must stay at its input coordinate: roof ridges/eaves/dormers/chimney; each window frame, pane and mullion; cedar siding, stone joints, star, porch posts, deck rail/lattice, walkway, birdbath, feeder pole and round red grill. Preserve ALL tree trunks, individual branches, leaves and their density. Preserve EXACT snow/frost boundaries, thickness, grass/leaf-litter patches. Do not add, remove, move, reshape, rescale, crop, zoom, change lens/perspective, straighten, or invent objects. Keep lower-left MLS watermark identical. Do not beautify architecture or smooth away texture.
ONLY change incident light, exposure, reflected color and restrained natural light falloff. DEEP DUSK, just after sunset. Retain the subtle peach/lavender horizon and cool open-sky fill. Give the remaining russet foliage, cedar and stone gentle luminous separation. Frost should catch soft skylight rather than look gray. Window and lantern light modest and warm, weaker than full night. No direct sun or new hard shadows.
Lift muddy shadows and midtones selectively by roughly half a photographic stop, preserving rich blacks and fine texture. Make materials feel dimensional through existing diffuse light, not HDR/local-contrast halos. Preserve highlight detail, natural restrained saturation and realistic cedar reds. Red grill stays dark red enamel, with only a subdued broad sky reflection, no bright daytime solar flare or chrome. Avoid orange outlines, fake spotlights, fog, bloom, heavy vignettes and a uniform blue/purple wash. Brightness can change; geometry, weather and season cannot. One full-frame image, no text, montage or comparison.
images.status: Registered Gemini lighting candidate for owner review

registration.algorithm: Robust affine fit to native Vision revision-1 flow on stable architectural texture; no dense warp

Aligned candidates had0px offset at12 sampled input-relative points; sample agreement is not pixel-perfect identity. Fine AI texture can change. These checks compare to v5, not summer; inherited full-sequence v4 alignment failures remain unresolved. Private concept only; not cleared for publication.
